tokens.note: primary = Nintendo red (#e60012), the brand's near-immutable signature, used identically on US (nintendo.com/us) and JP (nintendo.com/jp) surfaces — links, primary CTAs, logo. US text ink is #484848 with Geologica Variable; JP text ink is #3c3c3c with the YakuHan/Hiragino CJK stack. Translucent overlay/shadow values appear in prose/components only.
